Job Summary
As a Lead AI Engineer, you will own the design, delivery, and evolution of AI enabled legal solutions that support contract and compliance driven workflows across the enterprise. This role focuses on building and orchestrating agent based AI systems that integrate with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms and enterprise workflow tools to ensure AI is embedded into governed, auditable legal processes.
You will lead endtoend solution design from intake through execution and post signature intelligence while making informed buy vs. build decisions, providing delivery estimation, and implementing scalable, secure AI solution architecture. This role requires close partnership with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT, to deliver AI solutions that accelerate legal operations while maintaining regulatory and risk controls.
Key Responsibilities
Lead design and implementation of endtoend Legal AI workflows, including intake, orchestration, execution, and post signature intelligence
Evaluate and execute buy vs. build decisions for Legal AI capabilities, including delivery estimation, integration complexity, and total cost of ownership
Design and build custom AI agents to support legal use cases such as contract analysis, clause extraction, summarization, risk identification, and compliance validation
Implement orchestrated, multiagent systems that integrate AI services with CLM platforms and enterprise workflows
Architect and maintain secure, scalable integrations between AI systems and legal platforms, ensuring CLM remains the authoritative system of record
Establish engineering best practices for prompt design, agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and AI governance in legal contexts
Collaborate closely with Legal, Procurement, Compliance, and IT stakeholders to translate legal requirements into durable AI solutions
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers contributing to Legal AI initiatives
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
610+ years of experience designing and delivering software or AI enabled systems in production environments
Strong experience building LLM powered applications, agentic workflows, and AI driven services
Proven ability to design endtoend enterprise workflows, including integrations with multiple business systems
Strong programming experience in Python and API based integration development
Experience leveraging AI assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to accelerate agent development, integration, and iterative refinement
Demonstrated experience making architecture and delivery tradeoff decisions in complex enterprise environments
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or legal workflow platforms
Familiarity with legal or enterprise platforms such as Agiloft, Eudia, ServiceNow App Engine, GEP CLM, or similar systems
Domain knowledge in any of the following areas:
Procurement contracting
Commercial and vendor contract lifecycle management
Marketing compliance
Legal or regulatory affairs
Experience implementing AI solutions that clearly separate intelligence layers, workflow orchestration, and systems of record

Observational and event-driven reasoning
Workflow orchestration
Decision support

Enterprise integrations

Design and develop AI Agents for banking and financial services applications.
Build conversational AI systems for banking workflows.

Design AI-powered enterprise software solutions with strong focus on scalability, explainability, auditability, and security.

Core AI & Engineering Skills: Strong hands-on experience in designing and developing AI-powered applications. Practical experience working with: Small Language Models (SLMs) Large Language Models (LLMs) Fine-tuning and model optimization. Strong software engineering and system design capabilities. Job Summary

Role Overview
We are hiring a senior individual contributor to own and scale large-scale, OCR-driven document intelligence systems powered by self-hosted LLMs. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role focused on production systems that process long-form documents (200+ pages), extract structured data deterministically, and run on optimized GPU-backed inference infrastructure. You will work closely with the AI leadership team but will independently own architecture, performance, and reliability of document processing pipelines.


Responsibilities

Large-Scale Document Intelligence Pipelines: Design and build end-to-end pipelines for processing long-form, OCR-heavy documents; Own PDF ingestion, layout-aware parsing, and multi-page document assembly; Implement robust chunking, segmentation, and metadata tracking across long documents; Handle exception detection, retries, and deterministic failure handling; Optimize systems to reliably process 200+ page documents at scale.
OCR Structured Extraction Systems: Work with OCR engines (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, layout-aware models, vision-language models); Build layout-aware extraction systems using bounding boxes and structural metadata; Implement deterministic schema validation and cross-field consistency checks; Reduce reliance on manual QA through rule-based validation layers; Ensure traceability from extracted field back to source span.
Self-Hosted LLM Inference (Production Ownership): Deploy and operate open-source LLMs using: vLLM, Hugging Face TGI, GPU-backed serving stacks; Tune inference performance: KV cache management, Batching, Context window control, Throughput vs latency trade-offs; Monitor and optimize GPU utilization and cost per request; Own production reliability of LLM serving infrastructure.
Deterministic Validation Control Systems: Design validation layers outside the LLM; Implement schema enforcement, rule engines, invariants, and rejection logic; Build automated exception routing without default human review; Ensure auditability and reproducibility of extraction results; Create measurable correctness guarantees for high-stakes use cases.
Production Engineering Scale: Design systems that handle large document volumes, concurrency, failure states, observability and monitoring; Build logging, tracing, and metrics around document processing pipelines; Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade AI systems.


Required Experience

6+ years of hands-on Python engineering
Proven production experience building OCR-driven document pipelines
Experience handling long-form PDFs (100+ pages)
Strong experience with: vLLM or Hugging Face TGI
GPU-based LLM serving
Open-source LLMs (LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.)
Experience building deterministic validation systems (schema + rule enforcement)
Strong debugging and systems-level thinking
Ability to clearly articulate system trade-offs and business impact


Strongly Preferred

Experience with layout-aware models (LayoutLM, DocFormer, vision-language models)
Experience optimizing GPU cost and inference performance
Experience in regulated domains (healthcare, finance, compliance)
Familiarity with document-heavy workflows such as loan processing, underwriting, or claims

We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams

We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team

This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in LLMs, MLOps, and ML more broadly

This role can be remote

The Impact You Will Have

Develop LLM solutions on customer data such as RAG architectures on enterprise knowledge repos, querying structured data with natural language, and content generation

Build, scale, and optimize customer data science workloads and apply best in class MLOps to productionize these workloads across a variety of domains

Advise data teams on various data science such as architecture, tooling, and best practices

Present at conferences such as Data+AI Summit

Provide technical mentorship to the larger ML SME community in Databricks

Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to define priorities and influence the product roadmap

What we look for:

Experience building Generative AI applications, including RAG, agents, text2sql, fine-tuning, and deploying LLMs, with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI

5+ years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging typical machine learning and data science tools including pandas, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow/PyTorch

Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP

Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc ) or equivalent practical experience

Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike

Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML

[Preferred] Experience working with Databricks & Apache Spark to process large-scale distributed datasets
